summary.text: Kumulia Long is a Republican state representative from Chittenden-Franklin District who was appointed in April 2026 and is seeking election to a full term.
A real estate broker and Army National Guard veteran, he advanced from the Republican primary on August 11, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Long, also known as Kase, is a real estate broker and served in the U.S. Army National Guard from 2009 to 2020, according to Ballotpedia.
He ran for the Vermont State Senate in the Chittenden District in 2020 as a Republican and lost in the general election.
Governor Phil Scott (R) appointed him to the Vermont House of Representatives Chittenden-Franklin District seat on April 1, 2026, to replace Chris Taylor (R).
